implementation: Round 2 Receiving Manager deterministic decision engine (PO vs observations, strict UNCERTAIN) behind a Round 3 adapter. Observations are replayed from the sample CSV by default (RECEIVING_MODEL_MODE=replay, model.name=csv-replay); RECEIVING_MODEL_MODE=live sends data/input/<unit>/receiving/ captures to Gemini in one call.
notes: Ported from cube26-rcv-0138-kirantejz20005. No receiving captures are committed yet, so demo runs use the CSV replay.
